title: The Ext connecting map is composition with the extension class
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf] and Yoneda composition as in [lem-sc-p1-ext-yoneda-functoriality]. Let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with Yoneda class $\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$, and let $\mathcal F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Then the connecting map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal A)$ of the long exact sequence of [def-sc-ext-sheaf] for this short exact sequence sends $s$ to $\delta\circ s$.

source.place: Cohomology Lemma Tag 0B3A (boundary of the unit section is the extension class), in the general form for an arbitrary first argument

proof.text: Choose an injective-resolution model for the Ext groups in [def-sc-ext-sheaf]. Its long exact sequence in the second variable supplies the connecting map in the statement. By [lem-sc-p1-ext-resolution-derived-connecting], the canonical comparison with the derived-category Ext model identifies this resolution connecting map with the homology connecting morphism of the distinguished triangle attached to the short exact sequence; the degree-zero identification of a morphism s with its Ext^0 class is the one in [def-sc-ext-sheaf].

source.place: Tags 06XQ, 06XR and 05TE: injective-resolution Ext, derived Ext, and the long exact sequence of a right derived functor

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-p1-derived-connecting-extclass] in the abelian category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules to the distinguished triangle attached to $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$, with $Y=\mathcal F$, $n=0$, and the Ext^0 class represented by $s$. It identifies the connecting morphism with the derived composite $\delta\circ s$. By [lem-sc-ext-yoneda-composition-derived] this derived composite is precisely the Yoneda composite $\delta\circ s$ under the convention of the statement. Transporting across Step 1 gives the asserted value of the resolution-Ext connecting map.
